name: svg-draw-on-scroll
title: SVG Draw on Scroll
description: SVG strokes that draw themselves as the element scrolls through view, one path after another. Fully drawn under reduced motion.

props.name: paths
props.description: Path `d` strings in viewBox units, drawn one after another.

props.name: viewBox
props.description: SVG viewBox the paths are written in.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element that drives the drawing. Defaults to the page.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and color (text color sets the stroke).
